pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident INV-8273 fired for embedder-prod (eu-west-1). Symptoms: 5xx spike on /v1/embeddings. Priority: P1. https://pd.redwood.example/incidents/INV-8273

incidentbot: Auto-ack timer started (2m). Route: eng-oncall -> eng-sre.

vikram: Acked. I'm on it, joining bridge (zoom.us/j/1234).

olivia: Seeing multiple customer reports for dashboard timeouts in eu-west-1, several support tickets opened. Marking cust-impact = true.

vikram: Quick check - metrics show KV cache eviction bursts on kvcache-prod-3 and CPU at 95%. Suspect cache thrash after model rollout. Scaling kvcache now.

vikram: Running:
```kubectl -n inference scale deploy/kvcache-prod --replicas=6
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/embedder-prod --tail=100 | grep -i evict
pd incidents add-note INV-8273 "Scaled kvcache to 6 replicas; monitoring"
```

sre-bot: Autoscaler event: +2 nodes requested for inference-cluster-eu-west-1. ETA ~90s.

elaine: If you need a handoff I can take after 10m—I'm next on rotation. Any customer-facing mitigation planned?

vikram: Plan: scale cache + revert recent quantized variant (variant-b -> variant-a) if error rate doesn't drop. If revert needed, will use canary first. Handing off only if I need to rotate.

olivia: FYI PD suppression window is configured 00:00-02:00 UTC for routine noise. This is P1 so suppression should be ignored, but wanted to confirm behavior.

incidentbot: Suppression policy check: active suppression windows do NOT block P1 incidents. Continuing normal page flow.

vikram: Scaling complete, 2 nodes added. Error rate: 5xx down from 18% -> 7% over the last 60s. Latency improved slightly. Continuing to monitor for 5m.

elaine: Noted. If it flares back, consider activating dedicated-pool fallback: route embed requests to dedicated-embedder-v1 for high-SLA customers. I can prepare the routing change.

vikram: Good call. Preparing routing plan but holding until we see stabilization. If >10% errors persist after 5m I'll trigger fallback.

olivia: Posted customer update for impacted accounts: "We're investigating increased timeouts for embeddings in eu-west-1; engineers are on it."

vikram: Status update (5m): error rate steady ~6%, CPU settling ~65%. I expect full recovery in ~10m. Will close if stable for 3 consecutive minutes.

elaine: Copy, standing by for takeover if needed.

vikram: Resolved: error rate back to baseline, customers reporting recovery. Closing INV-8273 and adding notes for postmortem (kvcache eviction threshold + rollout gating). pd link updated.

incidentbot: Incident INV-8273 marked resolved by vikram. Postmortem owner set to vikram.

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: Incident closed. Thanks all for quick response!
